_meta.description: Offline static intelligence for Koramangala, Bengaluru. All facts are sourced from named authoritative public sources. Values estimated without direct measurement are marked with lower confidence.

bmtc._source: BMTC published route maps at bmtcinfo.com and DULT Bengaluru origin-destination survey 2022-23
bmtc._limitations: BMTC does not publish GTFS. Route counts and headways are estimates from DULT survey data, not real-time. Schedules subject to change.
bmtc.routeCountNote: Approximate count of BMTC routes passing through or terminating in Koramangala from DULT O-D survey 2022-23.

majorRoutes.description: Koramangala – Electronics City via Silk Board
Silk Board – Kempegowda BS (Volvo AC via ORR)
Koramangala – Kempegowda BS via Richmond Road
Koramangala – Yeshwanthpur via BEL Circle (Vajra AC)

bmtc.majorRoutesNote: Representative list only; verify current routes at bmtcinfo.com.

peakHeadwayMinutes.description: Typical peak-hour bus headway at Koramangala 4th Block and 80 Feet Road major stops

nammaMetro._source: BMRCL published Yellow Line Phase 2B alignment and Green Line station lists
nammaMetro._limitations: Yellow Line Phase 2B is under active construction. No station is operational in Koramangala as of July 2026.

nearbyStations.name: Silk Institute (Green Line)
nearbyStations.note: Nearest operational metro node; Silk Board junction ~4 km from Koramangala centre

nearbyStations.name: Koramangala (Yellow Line Phase 2B)
nearbyStations.note: Planned Yellow Line Phase 2B station; construction ongoing mid-2026

commuteDestinations._source: OpenStreetMap road network geometry; off-peak routing estimates via OSM topology
commuteDestinations._limitations: Drive times are indicative only. Bengaluru peak-hour congestion routinely doubles or triples off-peak times.

water._source: BWSSB published zone maps and annual reports 2022-23; Karnataka Jal Jeevan Mission ward data 2023
water._limitations: BWSSB does not publish a public API for real-time supply status. Individual street supply varies across Koramangala's blocks.
water.authority: Bengaluru Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB)
water.primaryWaterSource: Cauvery River — Stage III and IV treatment plants (T.K. Halli and Harohalli)
water.supplyFrequency: Alternate days; typically 1–2 hours per supply cycle depending on the block and pipeline zone
water.sewageSystem: BWSSB underground drainage; connection rates vary by block
water.notes: Inner Blocks (1–4) generally well-served by Cauvery pipeline. Outer blocks and high-ground areas may have more frequent borewell or tanker dependency. Pipeline connection rate estimated 70–80% of occupied buildings from BWSSB district reports.

electricity._source: KERC Annual Performance Review 2023-24; BESCOM annual report 2022-23
electricity._limitations: SAIDI and SAIFI are BESCOM-zone aggregates. Individual feeder reliability is not separately published.

ndvi._source: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance NDVI computation over Koramangala polygon via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. Analysis July 2024 (dry season). Reference: Ranagaswamy & Devaraj (2019), Remote Sensing Letters, Bengaluru NDVI urban ward analysis.
ndvi._license: Copernicus Sentinel data — free and open access under ESA Copernicus open data policy
ndvi._limitations: 10 m Sentinel-2 pixel; single dry-season composite. Seasonal NDVI varies ±0.08. Tree canopy overhanging roads may not be captured.
ndvi.ndviClassification: Low-moderate urban vegetation — mixed high-density residential and commercial with inner-block gardens and 80-Feet Road tree cover
ndvi.comparisonContext: Bengaluru urban NDVI average ~0.20–0.28 (Ranagaswamy & Devaraj 2019). Koramangala is slightly below city average in its commercial core; residential blocks 5–8 have higher NDVI.

heatIsland._source: Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature (Band 10); USGS Earth Explorer. Analysis comparing Koramangala polygon to rural reference ~30 km south (Anekal taluk), May 2024.
heatIsland._license: Landsat data is in the public domain (USGS/NASA)
heatIsland._limitations: 30 m Landsat thermal resolution. Surface temperature ≠ air temperature. Single-date pre-monsoon; seasonal variation is large.
heatIsland.uhiClassification: Moderate-high urban heat island — 80 Feet Road and ORR commercial stretches are primary hotspots

ward._source: BBMP published ward delimitation 2022; Census of India 2011; DULT land-use survey 2023
ward.areaNote: Koramangala spans multiple BBMP wards (approx. wards 130–137 across its 8 blocks). Ward 132 is used as the primary reference.
ward.populationNote: Approximate 2011 Census population across all Koramangala blocks; actual 2024 population is substantially higher due to apartment densification

complaints._source: BBMP Sahaaya grievance portal (FY 2022-23); iChangeMyCity ward reports; Citizen Matters investigative reports 2022-24
complaints._license: Public grievance portal data; attribution retained
complaints._limitations: Complaint counts reflect only registered grievances; under-reporting is significant. Complaint patterns vary substantially by sub-area across Koramangala's diverse blocks.

totalComplaintsPerYear.note: Approximate registered complaints across Koramangala wards, FY 2022-23

topCategories.note: 80 Feet Road service lanes and inter-block roads frequently reported. Construction heavy vehicle damage is a recurrent theme.
Commercial zones along 80 Feet Road and restaurant clusters generate significant solid waste.
Sections of 80 Feet Road and Agara Lake adjacent areas flood during heavy monsoon.
Elevated relative to city average; driven partly by high restaurant density.
Commercial blocks 4th–6th report persistent footpath and parking encroachment.

crime._source: NCRB Crime in India 2022 — Bengaluru City district-level; Karnataka SCRB Annual Report 2022
crime._limitations: Crime data is available only at city/district level. No open ward-level or locality-level crime breakdown is publicly available for Koramangala. Statistics reflect registered FIRs only.
crime.localityNote: Koramangala is served by Koramangala Police Station. No public database provides FIR counts or crime rates at ward or locality level. City-level data is displayed only as broader context — it cannot be attributed to Koramangala specifically.

internet._source: TRAI Broadband Report Q4 2023-24; Ookla Speedtest Global Index Bengaluru Q4 2023; ACT Fibernet, Airtel, Jio Fiber public coverage maps
internet._license: TRAI: public regulatory data; Ookla: research citations permitted
internet._limitations: TRAI data is circle-level, not locality-level. ISP coverage maps are indicative.
internet.fiberAvailability: High — Koramangala is one of Bengaluru's best-served localities for fiber broadband
